title: Nonnegativity conjecture for the truncated Bessel kernel
statement:
Let $K_M^\alpha(x)$ be the kernel defined in the paper, with $M\in\mathbb{N}$, $x\in[0,1]$, and real parameter $\alpha$. Numerical simulations suggest its nonnegativity for $0\leqslant\alpha\leqslant\frac{1}{2}$.

**Nonnegativity conjecture.** For all $0\leqslant\alpha\leqslant\frac{1}{2}$, $M\in\mathbb{N}$, and $x\in[0,1]$,

$$
K_M^\alpha(x)\geqslant 0.
$$

The claim is motivated by numerical simulations and is presented as a conjecture; no proof or disproof is supplied in the given text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17681

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
source_name: Ryan L. Acosta Babb, “A partial converse to the Riemann–Lebesgue lemma for Bessel–Fourier series of order zero”, arXiv:2410.17681 (2024).
